datasets.name: Sentinel-2 imagery (Jiuzhaigou)
datasets.source: European Space Agency’s Sentinel Scientific Data Hub
datasets.verbatim: Two Sentinel-2 images of pre- and post-event were acquired on July 29 and September 7, 2017 from the European Space Agency’s Sentinel Scientific Data Hub1, respectively. ... 1 Sentinel Scientific Data Hub: https://scihub.copernicus.eu.

datasets.name: PlanetScope imagery (Mainling)
datasets.verbatim: Two PlanetScope images were acquired on November 14 and December 19, 2017 from Planet Labs2. ... 2 Planet Labs: https://www.planet.com.

datasets.name: Landslide inventory (Jiuzhaigou)
datasets.verbatim: To make a quantitative evaluation, the co-seismic landslides interpreted in our former work are used as references, in which a polygon-based interpretation was carried out through pre-earthquake SPOT-5 images (2.5 m) and post-earthquake Gaofen-1/2 images (1 m) as well as UAV photographs (0.2 m) (Fan et al. 2018).

methods.name: CD-EMPES (Change detection-based co-seismic landslide mapping through extended morphological profiles and ensemble strategy)
methods.summary: An automated co-seismic landslide mapping approach that uses multi-threshold change vector analysis (CVA) for unsupervised sample generation, multi-scale extended morphological profiles (EMPs) for spatial feature extraction, and an ensemble of four machine learning classifiers (KNN, SVM, RF, and RoF) for landslide identification.
methods.verbatim: In order to address the aforementioned problems, a novel automated co-seismic landslide mapping approach (Simplified as CD-EMPES hereafter) is proposed.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced but not linked, and the input imagery is accessible via public providers. The custom code for the CD-EMPES method is not provided or linked.
